testo:
Triple Breaker
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may put the top 7 cards of your deck into your graveyard. For each creature with "Fushigiverse" put into your graveyard in this way, your opponent chooses a card in their hand and puts it into its owner's mana zone and chooses and destroys one of their creatures.
Fushigiverse
